  MATHEMATICAL FORMULATIONS & CONTROL THEORETIC DERIVATIONS:
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1. BEKKER-WONG NONLINEAR TRACK-SOIL MECHANICS FOR SATURATED ABYSSAL CLAY:
     The normal pressure distribution along the track contact length L is governed by the Bekker-Wong
     sinkage equation modified for saturated cohesive clay:
         p(x) = (k_c / b + k_phi) * z(x)^n_soil
     where:
         b      = track grouser width [m] (0.90 m)
         k_c    = cohesive modulus of soil deformation [kN / m^(n+1)]
         k_phi  = frictional modulus of soil deformation [kN / m^(n+2)]
         n_soil = sinkage exponent [-] (~0.8 to 1.1 for abyssal hemipelagic clay)
         z(x)   = vertical sinkage profile along track length x in [0, L] [m]

     The shear stress tau at longitudinal shear displacement j(x) is modeled by the Janbu-Wong
     exponential shear stress-displacement relationship for plastic cohesive soils:
         tau(j(x)) = tau_max * [ 1 - exp(-j(x) / K_w) ]
     where:
         tau_max = c_u + p(x) * tan(phi_soil)  (Mohr-Coulomb failure criterion)
         c_u     = undrained shear strength of saturated abyssal clay [kPa]
         phi_soil= internal friction angle of saturated clay [rad] (~2 deg to 6 deg)
         K_w     = Janbu shear deformation modulus / characteristic shear displacement [m] (~0.015 m)

     The shear displacement j(x) is accumulated from the track front idler (x = 0) to position x:
         j(x) = integral_0^x i_s * dx' = i_s * x
     where i_s is the kinematic slip ratio:
         i_s = (r_sprocket * omega_track - v_actual) / max(r_sprocket * omega_track, v_actual)

     Gross tractive thrust H developed by each track of width b and length L:
         H = b * integral_0^L tau(j(x)) dx

    rStbdSwashplateInternal := 0.0;

(* SECTION 1: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                 *)
(* Validates Triplicate Hydraulic Pressures, Ambient Hydrostatic, and Reservoir Margin      *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* --- 1.1 Port Drive Hydraulic Pressure (2oo3 Median Voting) --- *)
IF (rPress_PortDrive_A <= rPress_PortDrive_B AND rPress_PortDrive_B <= rPress_PortDrive_C) OR 
   (rPress_PortDrive_C <= rPress_PortDrive_B AND rPress_PortDrive_B <= rPress_PortDrive_A) THEN
    rVoted_Press_PortDrive := rPress_PortDrive_B;
ELSIF (rPress_PortDrive_B <= rPress_PortDrive_A AND rPress_PortDrive_A <= rPress_PortDrive_C) OR 
      (rPress_PortDrive_C <= rPress_PortDrive_A AND rPress_PortDrive_A <= rPress_PortDrive_B) THEN
    rVoted_Press_PortDrive := rPress_PortDrive_A;
ELSE
    rVoted_Press_PortDrive := rPress_PortDrive_C;
END_IF;

(* Discrepancy Diagnostics: Permissible tolerance 35.0 bar *)
bPortPress_Flt_A := ABS(rPress_PortDrive_A - rVoted_Press_PortDrive) > 35.0;
bPortPress_Flt_B := ABS(rPress_PortDrive_B - rVoted_Press_PortDrive) > 35.0;
bPortPress_Flt_C := ABS(rPress_PortDrive_C - rVoted_Press_PortDrive) > 35.0;
tonPortPress_Discrepancy(IN := (bPortPress_Flt_A OR bPortPress_Flt_B OR bPortPress_Flt_C), PT := T#250MS);
IF tonPortPress_Discrepancy.Q THEN
    dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Port Pressure 2oo3 Fault *)
    IF bPortPress_Flt_A THEN dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0000_0002; END_IF;
    IF bPortPress_Flt_B THEN dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0000_0004; END_IF;
    IF bPortPress_Flt_C THEN dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0000_0008; END_IF;
    iDegradationSeverityLevel := MAX(iDegradationSeverityLevel, 1);
END_IF;

(* --- 1.2 Starboard Drive Hydraulic Pressure (2oo3 Median Voting) --- *)
IF (rPress_StbdDrive_A <= rPress_StbdDrive_B AND rPress_StbdDrive_B <= rPress_StbdDrive_C) OR 
   (rPress_StbdDrive_C <= rPress_StbdDrive_B AND rPress_StbdDrive_B <= rPress_StbdDrive_A) THEN
    rVoted_Press_StbdDrive := rPress_StbdDrive_B;
ELSIF (rPress_StbdDrive_B <= rPress_StbdDrive_A AND rPress_StbdDrive_A <= rPress_StbdDrive_C) OR 
      (rPress_StbdDrive_C <= rPress_StbdDrive_A AND rPress_StbdDrive_A <= rPress_StbdDrive_B) THEN
    rVoted_Press_StbdDrive := rPress_StbdDrive_A;
ELSE
    rVoted_Press_StbdDrive := rPress_StbdDrive_C;
END_IF;

bStbdPress_Flt_A := ABS(rPress_StbdDrive_A - rVoted_Press_StbdDrive) > 35.0;
bStbdPress_Flt_B := ABS(rPress_StbdDrive_B - rVoted_Press_StbdDrive) > 35.0;
bStbdPress_Flt_C := ABS(rPress_StbdDrive_C - rVoted_Press_StbdDrive) > 35.0;
tonStbdPress_Discrepancy(IN := (bStbdPress_Flt_A OR bStbdPress_Flt_B OR bStbdPress_Flt_C), PT := T#250MS);
IF tonStbdPress_Discrepancy.Q THEN
    dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Stbd Pressure 2oo3 Fault *)
    IF bStbdPress_Flt_A THEN dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0000_0020; END_IF;
    IF bStbdPress_Flt_B THEN dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0000_0040; END_IF;
    IF bStbdPress_Flt_C THEN dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0000_0080; END_IF;
    iDegradationSeverityLevel := MAX(iDegradationSeverityLevel, 1);

(* --- 1.3 Ambient Hydrostatic Pressure at 6,000m (2oo3 Median Voting) --- *)
IF (rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_A <= rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_B AND rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_B <= rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_C) OR 
   (rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_C <= rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_B AND rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_B <= rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_A) THEN
    rVoted_Press_Hydrostatic := rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_B;
ELSIF (rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_B <= rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_A AND rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_A <= rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_C) OR 
      (rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_C <= rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_A AND rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_A <= rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_B) THEN
    rVoted_Press_Hydrostatic := rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_A;
ELSE
    rVoted_Press_Hydrostatic := rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_C;
END_IF;

bHydroPress_Flt_A := ABS(rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_A - rVoted_Press_Hydrostatic) > 15.0;
bHydroPress_Flt_B := ABS(rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_B - rVoted_Press_Hydrostatic) > 15.0;
bHydroPress_Flt_C := ABS(rPress_HydrostaticAmbient_C - rVoted_Press_Hydrostatic) > 15.0;
tonHydroPress_Discrepancy(IN := (bHydroPress_Flt_A OR bHydroPress_Flt_B OR bHydroPress_Flt_C), PT := T#500MS);
IF tonHydroPress_Discrepancy.Q THEN
    dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Hydrostatic 2oo3 Fault *)
    iDegradationSeverityLevel := MAX(iDegradationSeverityLevel, 1);

(* --- 1.4 Reservoir Compensation Positive Margin (2oo3 Median Voting) --- *)
IF (rPress_CompensatorDelta_A <= rPress_CompensatorDelta_B AND rPress_CompensatorDelta_B <= rPress_CompensatorDelta_C) OR 
   (rPress_CompensatorDelta_C <= rPress_CompensatorDelta_B AND rPress_CompensatorDelta_B <= rPress_CompensatorDelta_A) THEN
    rVoted_Press_Compensator := rPress_CompensatorDelta_B;
ELSIF (rPress_CompensatorDelta_B <= rPress_CompensatorDelta_A AND rPress_CompensatorDelta_A <= rPress_CompensatorDelta_C) OR 
      (rPress_CompensatorDelta_C <= rPress_CompensatorDelta_A AND rPress_CompensatorDelta_A <= rPress_CompensatorDelta_B) THEN
    rVoted_Press_Compensator := rPress_CompensatorDelta_A;
ELSE
    rVoted_Press_Compensator := rPress_CompensatorDelta_C;
END_IF;

bCompPress_Flt_A := ABS(rPress_CompensatorDelta_A - rVoted_Press_Compensator) > 0.45;
bCompPress_Flt_B := ABS(rPress_CompensatorDelta_B - rVoted_Press_Compensator) > 0.45;
bCompPress_Flt_C := ABS(rPress_CompensatorDelta_C - rVoted_Press_Compensator) > 0.45;
tonCompPress_Discrepancy(IN := (bCompPress_Flt_A OR bCompPress_Flt_B OR bCompPress_Flt_C), PT := T#500MS);
IF tonCompPress_Discrepancy.Q THEN
    dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0000_1000; (* Bit 12: Compensator 2oo3 Fault *)
END_IF;

(* --- 1.5 Track Hydraulic Drive Motors Dual-Channel Speed Voting --- *)
rVoted_PortMotorSpeed := 0.5 * (rPortMotorSpeed_A + rPortMotorSpeed_B);
rVoted_StbdMotorSpeed := 0.5 * (rStbdMotorSpeed_A + rStbdMotorSpeed_B);
IF ABS(rPortMotorSpeed_A - rPortMotorSpeed_B) > 20.0 THEN
    dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0001_0000; (* Bit 16: Port Speed Encoder Mismatch *)
END_IF;
IF ABS(rStbdMotorSpeed_A - rStbdMotorSpeed_B) > 20.0 THEN
    dwSensorVotingFaultWord := dwSensorVotingFaultWord OR 16#0002_0000; (* Bit 17: Stbd Speed Encoder Mismatch *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 2: HYDROSTATIC COMPENSATION & RESERVOIR SAFETY INTERLOCKS                        *)
(* Deep-sea electronic enclosures and hydraulic loops must maintain P_res > P_amb           *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rVoted_Press_Compensator < 0.50 THEN
    (* Critical Loss of Positive Reservoir Margin: Seawater Ingression Hazard at 600 bar *)
    dwSystemAlarmWord1 := dwSystemAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Compensation Pressure Collapse *)
    dwHydraulicHealthWord := dwHydraulicHealthWord AND 16#FFFF_FFFE;
    rHydraulicBypassDumpValve := 0.0;
    (* Throttle pump speed and initiate graceful abort upon persistence *)
ELSIF rVoted_Press_Compensator > 3.50 THEN
    (* Bladder Over-Expansion Warning: Risk of seal rupture *)
    dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Bladder Overpressure Warning *)
ELSE
    dwSystemAlarmWord1 := dwSystemAlarmWord1 AND 16#FFFB;
    dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 AND 16#FFFE;
    dwHydraulicHealthWord := dwHydraulicHealthWord OR 16#0000_0002;
END_IF;

(* Circuit Hydraulic Overpressure Supervision: 380.0 bar Continuous Rating *)
tonHighPressureDebounce(IN := (rVoted_Press_PortDrive > rMaxHydraulicPressureBar OR 
                               rVoted_Press_StbdDrive > rMaxHydraulicPressureBar), PT := T#150MS);
IF tonHighPressureDebounce.Q THEN
    dwSystemAlarmWord1 := dwSystemAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Hydraulic Circuit Overpressure *)
    rHydraulicBypassDumpValve := 45.0; (* Proportionally dump circuit spike *)
ELSE
    rHydraulicBypassDumpValve := 0.0;
    dwSystemAlarmWord1 := dwSystemAlarmWord1 AND 16#FFF7;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 3: USBL ACOUSTIC RAY TRACING, SVP REFRACTION & LATENCY COMPENSATION              *)
(* Integrates Snell's Law across stratified water column for 6,000m slant range             *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 3.1 Abyssal Mean Sound Velocity Calculation (Mackenzie Benthic Boundary Layer) *)
rMeanSoundVelocity := 1448.96 
                    + 4.591 * 1.80 
                    - 0.05304 * (1.80 * 1.80) 
                    + 1.340 * (34.80 - 35.0) 
                    + 0.01630 * rDigiquartzDepth 
                    + 1.675E-7 * (rDigiquartzDepth * rDigiquartzDepth);

(* 3.2 Snell's Law Constant Ray Parameter p_ray *)
(* Depression angle rUSBL_ElevationAngle is negative, convert to incident angle from vertical *)
rTmpA := ABS(rUSBL_ElevationAngle) * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD;
IF rTmpA > 1.553 THEN rTmpA := 1.553; END_IF; (* Bound to 89 deg to prevent singularity *)
rRayParameter_p := SIN(rTmpA) / rUSBL_SoundSpeedSurface;

(* 3.3 Refraction Ray-Tracing Horizontal Distance & Depth Correction *)
(* Harmonic mean sound speed compensation along refracted arc *)
rAcousticRay_Depth_Z := rUSBL_SlantRange * SIN(rTmpA);
rAcousticRay_HorizDist := rUSBL_SlantRange * COS(rTmpA) * (rMeanSoundVelocity / rUSBL_SoundSpeedSurface);

(* 3.4 Geodetic Position Projection from Topside RTK-GNSS Coordinates *)
rTmpB := rUSBL_BearingAngle * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD;
rUSBL_RawEast_Calc := rTopsideVessel_East + rAcousticRay_HorizDist * SIN(rTmpB);
rUSBL_RawNorth_Calc := rTopsideVessel_North + rAcousticRay_HorizDist * COS(rTmpB);

(* 3.5 Latency Ring Buffer Storage (Delayed-State FIFO for 4.0s Hydro-Acoustic Latency) *)
aHistory_PosEast[iBufferWriteIndex] := aEKF_State[0];
aHistory_PosNorth[iBufferWriteIndex] := aEKF_State[1];
aHistory_DepthZ[iBufferWriteIndex] := aEKF_State[2];
iBufferWriteIndex := (iBufferWriteIndex + 1) MOD 16;

(* 3.6 Acoustic Signal Quality & Outlier Rejection via Normalized Innovation Squared (NIS) *)
rAcousticTimeLatency_s := rUSBL_PingTravelTime * 0.001;
tonAcousticPingWatchdog(IN := (diUSBL_PingCounter = diUSBL_PingCounter), PT := T#12S);

IF rUSBL_AcousticSNR < 6.0 OR tonAcousticPingWatchdog.Q THEN
    (* Low SNR or Acoustic Ping Dropout: Flag dropout dead-reckoning *)
    bAcousticDropoutActive := TRUE;
    dwAcousticHealthWord := dwAcousticHealthWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: USBL Acoustic Dropout *)
ELSE
    bAcousticDropoutActive := FALSE;
    dwAcousticHealthWord := dwAcousticHealthWord AND 16#FFFD;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 4: 9-STATE STRAPDOWN INS / DVL / USBL EXTENDED KALMAN FILTER (EKF)                *)
(* States: [X, Y, Z, Vx, Vy, Vz, Roll, Pitch, Yaw] in R^9                                    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 4.1 Strapdown Attitude & Angular Rate Integration (Euler Angles) *)
aEKF_State[6] := aEKF_State[6] + (rINS_GyroRate_X * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD) * 0.050; (* Roll *)
aEKF_State[7] := aEKF_State[7] + (rINS_GyroRate_Y * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD) * 0.050; (* Pitch *)
aEKF_State[8] := aEKF_State[8] + (rINS_GyroRate_Z * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD) * 0.050; (* Yaw *)

(* Normalize Yaw Heading to [0, 2*PI) *)
IF aEKF_State[8] >= (2.0 * CONST_PI) THEN
    aEKF_State[8] := aEKF_State[8] - (2.0 * CONST_PI);
ELSIF aEKF_State[8] < 0.0 THEN
    aEKF_State[8] := aEKF_State[8] + (2.0 * CONST_PI);
END_IF;

(* 4.2 Body-to-Navigation Coordinate Transformation for Accelerations *)
rTmpA := COS(aEKF_State[8]); (* Cos(Yaw) *)
rTmpB := SIN(aEKF_State[8]); (* Sin(Yaw) *)

(* 4.3 Inertial State Propagation (A-Priori Prediction x_k|k-1) *)
aEKF_StatePredict[3] := aEKF_State[3] + (rINS_Accel_X * rTmpA - rINS_Accel_Y * rTmpB) * 0.050;
aEKF_StatePredict[4] := aEKF_State[4] + (rINS_Accel_X * rTmpB + rINS_Accel_Y * rTmpA) * 0.050;
aEKF_StatePredict[5] := aEKF_State[5] + (rINS_Accel_Z - CONST_GRAVITY_ABYSSAL) * 0.050;

aEKF_StatePredict[0] := aEKF_State[0] + aEKF_StatePredict[3] * 0.050;
aEKF_StatePredict[1] := aEKF_State[1] + aEKF_StatePredict[4] * 0.050;
aEKF_StatePredict[2] := aEKF_State[2] + aEKF_StatePredict[5] * 0.050;

(* Propagate Diagonal Covariance with Process Noise *)
aEKF_DiagCovariance[0] := aEKF_DiagCovariance[0] + aEKF_DiagCovariance[3] * 0.050 + 0.0025;
aEKF_DiagCovariance[1] := aEKF_DiagCovariance[1] + aEKF_DiagCovariance[4] * 0.050 + 0.0025;
aEKF_DiagCovariance[2] := aEKF_DiagCovariance[2] + aEKF_DiagCovariance[5] * 0.050 + 0.0010;
aEKF_DiagCovariance[3] := aEKF_DiagCovariance[3] + 0.0015;
aEKF_DiagCovariance[4] := aEKF_DiagCovariance[4] + 0.0015;
aEKF_DiagCovariance[5] := aEKF_DiagCovariance[5] + 0.0008;

(* 4.4 DVL Bottom-Track Velocity Fusion (High-Frequency 20 Hz Update) *)
IF bDVL_BottomLockValid THEN
    (* Transform DVL Surge/Sway into Navigation Frame *)
    rTmpC := rDVL_Velocity_Surge_X * rTmpA - rDVL_Velocity_Sway_Y * rTmpB;
    rTmpDiff := rDVL_Velocity_Surge_X * rTmpB + rDVL_Velocity_Sway_Y * rTmpA;
    
    (* Velocity Kalman Gain K_v = P_v / (P_v + R_dvl) *)
    aEKF_KalmanGain_Vel[3] := aEKF_DiagCovariance[3] / (aEKF_DiagCovariance[3] + 0.0004);
    aEKF_KalmanGain_Vel[4] := aEKF_DiagCovariance[4] / (aEKF_DiagCovariance[4] + 0.0004);
    
    (* Correct Velocities *)
    aEKF_State[3] := aEKF_StatePredict[3] + aEKF_KalmanGain_Vel[3] * (rTmpC - aEKF_StatePredict[3]);
    aEKF_State[4] := aEKF_StatePredict[4] + aEKF_KalmanGain_Vel[4] * (rTmpDiff - aEKF_StatePredict[4]);
    
    (* Update Covariance *)
    aEKF_DiagCovariance[3] := (1.0 - aEKF_KalmanGain_Vel[3]) * aEKF_DiagCovariance[3];
    aEKF_DiagCovariance[4] := (1.0 - aEKF_KalmanGain_Vel[4]) * aEKF_DiagCovariance[4];
ELSE
    aEKF_State[3] := aEKF_StatePredict[3];
    aEKF_State[4] := aEKF_StatePredict[4];
END_IF;

(* Depth Fusion from Resonant Digiquartz Quartz Sensor *)
aEKF_State[2] := aEKF_StatePredict[2] + 0.15 * (rDigiquartzDepth - aEKF_StatePredict[2]);
aEKF_DiagCovariance[2] := 0.85 * aEKF_DiagCovariance[2];

(* 4.5 USBL Acoustic Position Fusion with Chi-Square Innovation Gating *)
IF NOT bAcousticDropoutActive AND bAcousticTransponderSync THEN
    (* Calculate Innovation Residual against latency-delayed state *)
    rTmpA := rUSBL_RawEast_Calc - aEKF_StatePredict[0];
    rTmpB := rUSBL_RawNorth_Calc - aEKF_StatePredict[1];
    
    (* Innovation Covariance S = H * P * H^T + R *)
    rTmpC := aEKF_DiagCovariance[0] + 4.50; (* USBL East variance R = 4.5 m^2 *)
    rTmpDiff := aEKF_DiagCovariance[1] + 4.50; (* USBL North variance R = 4.5 m^2 *)
    
    (* Normalized Innovation Squared (NIS): gamma = y_tilde^T * S^-1 * y_tilde *)
    rNIS_ChiSquare_Value := (rTmpA * rTmpA) / rTmpC + (rTmpB * rTmpB) / rTmpDiff;
    rAcousticInnovationResidual := SQRT(rTmpA * rTmpA + rTmpB * rTmpB);
    
    (* Chi-Square 2-DOF 99% Confidence Gating Threshold = 9.21 *)
    IF rNIS_ChiSquare_Value <= 9.21 THEN
        (* Accept Acoustic Ping: Compute Position Kalman Gain *)
        aEKF_KalmanGain_Pos[0] := aEKF_DiagCovariance[0] / rTmpC;
        aEKF_KalmanGain_Pos[1] := aEKF_DiagCovariance[1] / rTmpDiff;
        
        aEKF_State[0] := aEKF_StatePredict[0] + aEKF_KalmanGain_Pos[0] * rTmpA;
        aEKF_State[1] := aEKF_StatePredict[1] + aEKF_KalmanGain_Pos[1] * rTmpB;
        
        aEKF_DiagCovariance[0] := (1.0 - aEKF_KalmanGain_Pos[0]) * aEKF_DiagCovariance[0];
        aEKF_DiagCovariance[1] := (1.0 - aEKF_KalmanGain_Pos[1]) * aEKF_DiagCovariance[1];
        
        rLastValid_USBL_East := aEKF_State[0];
        rLastValid_USBL_North := aEKF_State[1];
        bAcousticOutlierRejected := FALSE;
        dwAcousticHealthWord := dwAcousticHealthWord AND 16#FFFB; (* Clear Bit 2 *)
    ELSE
        (* Reject as Acoustic Multipath Outlier Spike *)
        bAcousticOutlierRejected := TRUE;
        dwAcousticHealthWord := dwAcousticHealthWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Outlier Gated *)
        dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Acoustic Outlier Reject *)
        aEKF_State[0] := aEKF_StatePredict[0];
        aEKF_State[1] := aEKF_StatePredict[1];
    END_IF;
ELSE
    aEKF_State[0] := aEKF_StatePredict[0];
    aEKF_State[1] := aEKF_StatePredict[1];
END_IF;

(* Assign Navigation Outputs *)
rFusedPosition_East := aEKF_State[0];
rFusedPosition_North := aEKF_State[1];
rFusedDepth_Z := aEKF_State[2];
rFusedForwardVelocity := aEKF_State[3] * COS(aEKF_State[8]) + aEKF_State[4] * SIN(aEKF_State[8]);
rFusedTransverseVelocity := -aEKF_State[3] * SIN(aEKF_State[8]) + aEKF_State[4] * COS(aEKF_State[8]);
rFusedYawHeading := aEKF_State[8] * CONST_RAD_TO_DEG;
rFusedRollAngle := aEKF_State[6] * CONST_RAD_TO_DEG;
rFusedPitchAngle := aEKF_State[7] * CONST_RAD_TO_DEG;

(* Statistical Filter Health Index *)
rEKF_ConfidenceIndex := 100.0 - 5.0 * (aEKF_DiagCovariance[0] + aEKF_DiagCovariance[1]);
IF rEKF_ConfidenceIndex < 10.0 THEN rEKF_ConfidenceIndex := 10.0; END_IF;
IF rEKF_ConfidenceIndex > 100.0 THEN rEKF_ConfidenceIndex := 100.0; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 5: BEKKER-WONG SATURATED CLAY TERRAMECHANICS & DYNAMIC TRACK SLIP ESTIMATION     *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 5.1 Track Theoretical Linear Speeds from Motor Angular Velocity *)
(* v_th = (omega_motor / i_gearbox) * r_sprocket *)
rTrackTheoreticalSpeed_L := (rVoted_PortMotorSpeed * (2.0 * CONST_PI / 60.0) / CONST_GEARBOX_RATIO) * CONST_SPROCKET_RADIUS;
rTrackTheoreticalSpeed_R := (rVoted_StbdMotorSpeed * (2.0 * CONST_PI / 60.0) / CONST_GEARBOX_RATIO) * CONST_SPROCKET_RADIUS;

(* 5.2 Kinematic Slip Ratio Estimation (i_s) *)
rTmpA := MAX(ABS(rTrackTheoreticalSpeed_L), 0.015);
IF rTrackTheoreticalSpeed_L >= 0.0 THEN
    rPortTrackSlipRatio := (rTrackTheoreticalSpeed_L - rFusedForwardVelocity) / rTmpA;
ELSE
    rPortTrackSlipRatio := 0.0;
END_IF;
(* Clamp slip ratio between 0.0 and 1.0 *)
IF rPortTrackSlipRatio < 0.0 THEN rPortTrackSlipRatio := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rPortTrackSlipRatio > 1.0 THEN rPortTrackSlipRatio := 1.0; END_IF;

rTmpB := MAX(ABS(rTrackTheoreticalSpeed_R), 0.015);
IF rTrackTheoreticalSpeed_R >= 0.0 THEN
    rStbdTrackSlipRatio := (rTrackTheoreticalSpeed_R - rFusedForwardVelocity) / rTmpB;
ELSE
    rStbdTrackSlipRatio := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rStbdTrackSlipRatio < 0.0 THEN rStbdTrackSlipRatio := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rStbdTrackSlipRatio > 1.0 THEN rStbdTrackSlipRatio := 1.0; END_IF;

(* 5.3 Saturated Clay Cyclic Remolding & Shear Degradation *)
(* c_u(t) decays toward residual shear strength c_u_rem = c_u_peak / S_t under cyclic slip *)
rAccumulatedSlip_Port := rAccumulatedSlip_Port + ABS(rPortTrackSlipRatio) * 0.050;
rAccumulatedSlip_Stbd := rAccumulatedSlip_Stbd + ABS(rStbdTrackSlipRatio) * 0.050;
rTmpC := 0.5 * (rAccumulatedSlip_Port + rAccumulatedSlip_Stbd);

rRemoldedSoilShear_c_u := (rSedimentCohesion_Nominal / rSedimentSensitivity_St) 
                        + (rSedimentCohesion_Nominal - (rSedimentCohesion_Nominal / rSedimentSensitivity_St)) 
                        * EXP(-0.045 * rTmpC);
rSoilShearStrength_Est := rRemoldedSoilShear_c_u;

(* 5.4 Janbu-Wong Gross Thrust Formulation *)
(* H = b * [c_u + p*tan(phi)] * [ L + (K_w / i_s) * (exp(-i_s * L / K_w) - 1) ] *)
rTmpA := rRemoldedSoilShear_c_u + rNormalGroundPressure * TAN(rSedimentFrictionAngle * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD);

IF rPortTrackSlipRatio > 0.005 THEN
    rTmpB := rPortTrackSlipRatio * CONST_TRACK_LENGTH_L / rJanbuModulus_Nominal;
    IF rTmpB > 12.0 THEN rTmpB := 12.0; END_IF;
    rGrossTractionThrust_L := CONST_TRACK_WIDTH_B * rTmpA * (CONST_TRACK_LENGTH_L + (rJanbuModulus_Nominal / rPortTrackSlipRatio) * (EXP(-rTmpB) - 1.0));
ELSE
    rGrossTractionThrust_L := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rStbdTrackSlipRatio > 0.005 THEN
    rTmpC := rStbdTrackSlipRatio * CONST_TRACK_LENGTH_L / rJanbuModulus_Nominal;
    IF rTmpC > 12.0 THEN rTmpC := 12.0; END_IF;
    rGrossTractionThrust_R := CONST_TRACK_WIDTH_B * rTmpA * (CONST_TRACK_LENGTH_L + (rJanbuModulus_Nominal / rStbdTrackSlipRatio) * (EXP(-rTmpC) - 1.0));
ELSE
    rGrossTractionThrust_R := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 6: DYNAMIC SLIP SINKAGE & BELLY GROUNDING DETECTION                               *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 6.1 Slip-Sinkage Grouser Excavation Rate *)
(* dz_slip / dt = h_grouser * alpha_excav * |i_s| * (v_x / L) *)
rTmpA := 0.5 * (rPortTrackSlipRatio + rStbdTrackSlipRatio);
IF rTmpA > 0.12 THEN
    rDynamicExcavationDepth := rDynamicExcavationDepth + (rGrouserHeight * 0.35 * rTmpA * (MAX(rFusedForwardVelocity, 0.05) / CONST_TRACK_LENGTH_L)) * 0.050;
END_IF;
IF rDynamicExcavationDepth > 0.350 THEN rDynamicExcavationDepth := 0.350; END_IF;

(* Total Dynamic Sinkage = Static Bearing Sinkage (0.045m) + Dynamic Slip Excavation *)
rEstimatedDynamicSinkage := 0.045 + rDynamicExcavationDepth;

(* Physical Clearance to Belly Pan *)
rBellyGroundingMargin := CONST_CHASSIS_NOM_CLEAR - rEstimatedDynamicSinkage;

(* Belly Grounding Proximity Alarm & Interlock *)
tonBellyGroundingDebounce(IN := (rBellyGroundingMargin <= CONST_CRITICAL_BELLY_CLR), PT := T#200MS);
IF tonBellyGroundingDebounce.Q THEN
    dwSystemAlarmWord1 := dwSystemAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Belly Grounding Trip *)
    iState := 50; (* Force to SLIP MITIGATION & BELLY RECOVERY STATE *)
    iDegradationSeverityLevel := MAX(iDegradationSeverityLevel, 2);
ELSE
    dwSystemAlarmWord1 := dwSystemAlarmWord1 AND 16#FFEF;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 7: CRAWLER STATE-SPACE MOBILITY MATRIX UPDATE (A, B, C, D)                        *)
(* Linearized at Current Slip and Hydrostatic Pressure Operating Point                       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Mobility State Vector: x = [v_x, omega_z, i_s_L, i_s_R, Delta_p_L, Delta_p_R]^T *)
aMPC_State[0] := rFusedForwardVelocity;
aMPC_State[1] := rINS_GyroRate_Z * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD;
aMPC_State[2] := rPortTrackSlipRatio;
aMPC_State[3] := rStbdTrackSlipRatio;
aMPC_State[4] := rVoted_Press_PortDrive;
aMPC_State[5] := rVoted_Press_StbdDrive;

(* Continuous-to-Discrete State Matrix A (Sample time T_s = 0.050 s) *)
aMPC_A[0, 0] := 0.885; aMPC_A[0, 1] := 0.000; aMPC_A[0, 2] := -0.142; aMPC_A[0, 3] := -0.142; aMPC_A[0, 4] := 0.0035; aMPC_A[0, 5] := 0.0035;
aMPC_A[1, 0] := 0.000; aMPC_A[1, 1] := 0.820; aMPC_A[1, 2] := -0.210; aMPC_A[1, 3] := 0.210;  aMPC_A[1, 4] := -0.0048; aMPC_A[1, 5] := 0.0048;
aMPC_A[2, 0] := 0.000; aMPC_A[2, 1] := 0.000; aMPC_A[2, 2] := 0.750;  aMPC_A[2, 3] := 0.000;  aMPC_A[2, 4] := 0.0012; aMPC_A[2, 5] := 0.0000;
aMPC_A[3, 0] := 0.000; aMPC_A[3, 1] := 0.000; aMPC_A[3, 2] := 0.000;  aMPC_A[3, 3] := 0.750;  aMPC_A[3, 4] := 0.0000; aMPC_A[3, 5] := 0.0012;
aMPC_A[4, 0] := -2.50; aMPC_A[4, 1] := -1.20; aMPC_A[4, 2] := 1.850;  aMPC_A[4, 3] := 0.000;  aMPC_A[4, 4] := 0.9100; aMPC_A[4, 5] := 0.0000;
aMPC_A[5, 0] := -2.50; aMPC_A[5, 1] := 1.200; aMPC_A[5, 2] := 0.000;  aMPC_A[5, 3] := 1.850;  aMPC_A[5, 4] := 0.0000; aMPC_A[5, 5] := 0.9100;

(* Control Matrix B (Swashplate Inputs alpha_L, alpha_R) *)
aMPC_B[0, 0] := 0.0000; aMPC_B[0, 1] := 0.0000;
aMPC_B[1, 0] := 0.0000; aMPC_B[1, 1] := 0.0000;
aMPC_B[2, 0] := 0.0028; aMPC_B[2, 1] := 0.0000;
aMPC_B[3, 0] := 0.0000; aMPC_B[3, 1] := 0.0028;
aMPC_B[4, 0] := 0.2850; aMPC_B[4, 1] := 0.0000;
aMPC_B[5, 0] := 0.0000; aMPC_B[5, 1] := 0.2850;

(* Output Matrix C: y = [v_x, omega_z, i_s_L, i_s_R]^T *)
aMPC_C[0, 0] := 1.0; aMPC_C[0, 1] := 0.0; aMPC_C[0, 2] := 0.0; aMPC_C[0, 3] := 0.0; aMPC_C[0, 4] := 0.0; aMPC_C[0, 5] := 0.0;
aMPC_C[1, 0] := 0.0; aMPC_C[1, 1] := 1.0; aMPC_C[1, 2] := 0.0; aMPC_C[1, 3] := 0.0; aMPC_C[1, 4] := 0.0; aMPC_C[1, 5] := 0.0;
aMPC_C[2, 0] := 0.0; aMPC_C[2, 1] := 0.0; aMPC_C[2, 2] := 1.0; aMPC_C[2, 3] := 0.0; aMPC_C[2, 4] := 0.0; aMPC_C[2, 5] := 0.0;
aMPC_C[3, 0] := 0.0; aMPC_C[3, 1] := 0.0; aMPC_C[3, 2] := 0.0; aMPC_C[3, 3] := 1.0; aMPC_C[3, 4] := 0.0; aMPC_C[3, 5] := 0.0;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 8: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC PROGRAMMING SOLVER                   *)
(* Optimizes Dual Variable-Displacement Pump Swashplate Angles                              *)
(* Cost: J = 1/2 * Delta_u^T * H * Delta_u + g^T * Delta_u                                  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 8.1 Waypoint Guidance & Desired Heading Law *)
rTmpA := rTargetWaypoint_East - rFusedPosition_East;
rTmpB := rTargetWaypoint_North - rFusedPosition_North;
rDistToWaypoint := SQRT(rTmpA * rTmpA + rTmpB * rTmpB);

IF rDistToWaypoint > 1.0 THEN
    (* Desired Heading Angle *)
    rWaypointAngleRad := ATAN2(rTmpA, rTmpB);
    rYawErrorRad := rWaypointAngleRad - aEKF_State[8];
    (* Normalize Heading Error to [-PI, +PI] *)
    WHILE rYawErrorRad > CONST_PI DO rYawErrorRad := rYawErrorRad - (2.0 * CONST_PI); END_WHILE;
    WHILE rYawErrorRad < -CONST_PI DO rYawErrorRad := rYawErrorRad + (2.0 * CONST_PI); END_WHILE;
ELSE
    rYawErrorRad := (rTargetHeading_Yaw * CONST_DEG_TO_RAD) - aEKF_State[8];
END_IF;

(* Reference Outputs *)
aMPC_Target[0] := rTargetForwardVelocity; (* Forward Velocity [m/s] *)
aMPC_Target[1] := 0.45 * rYawErrorRad;    (* Proportional Steering Angular Rate [rad/s] *)
aMPC_Target[2] := 0.10;                   (* Desired Port Slip Ratio [-] *)
aMPC_Target[3] := 0.10;                   (* Desired Stbd Slip Ratio [-] *)

(* Output Tracking Penalty Weights *)
aMPC_Weight_Q[0] := 45.0;  (* Forward velocity tracking weight *)
aMPC_Weight_Q[1] := 120.0; (* Heading yaw rate tracking weight *)
aMPC_Weight_Q[2] := 250.0; (* Slip ratio suppression weight Port *)
aMPC_Weight_Q[3] := 250.0; (* Slip ratio suppression weight Stbd *)

(* Control Penalty Weights *)
aMPC_Weight_R[0] := 1.25;  (* Port Swashplate slew rate penalty *)
aMPC_Weight_R[1] := 1.25;  (* Stbd Swashplate slew rate penalty *)
aMPC_Weight_S[0] := 0.05;  (* Port Absolute control effort *)
aMPC_Weight_S[1] := 0.05;  (* Stbd Absolute control effort *)

(* 8.2 QP Hessian Matrix H = 2 * (B^T * C^T * Q * C * B + R + S) *)
rHessian_11 := 2.0 * (0.0028 * 0.0028 * aMPC_Weight_Q[2] + 0.285 * 0.285 * 0.0015 + aMPC_Weight_R[0] + aMPC_Weight_S[0]);
rHessian_22 := 2.0 * (0.0028 * 0.0028 * aMPC_Weight_Q[3] + 0.285 * 0.285 * 0.0015 + aMPC_Weight_R[1] + aMPC_Weight_S[1]);
rHessian_12 := 0.0005; (* Minimal cross-channel hydraulic coupling *)
rHessian_21 := 0.0005;

(* 8.3 QP Linear Gradient Vector g = 2 * B^T * C^T * Q * (C*A*x - y_ref) *)
rTmpA := (aMPC_State[0] - aMPC_Target[0]) * aMPC_Weight_Q[0];
rTmpB := (aMPC_State[1] - aMPC_Target[1]) * aMPC_Weight_Q[1];
rTmpC := (aMPC_State[2] - aMPC_Target[2]) * aMPC_Weight_Q[2];
rTmpDiff := (aMPC_State[3] - aMPC_Target[3]) * aMPC_Weight_Q[3];

rGradient_1 := 2.0 * (0.015 * rTmpA - 0.025 * rTmpB + 0.0028 * rTmpC + 0.08 * aMPC_Weight_S[0] * rPortSwashplateInternal);
rGradient_2 := 2.0 * (0.015 * rTmpA + 0.025 * rTmpB + 0.0028 * rTmpDiff + 0.08 * aMPC_Weight_S[1] * rStbdSwashplateInternal);

(* 8.4 Analytical 2x2 Symmetric Matrix Inversion *)
rDetHess := (rHessian_11 * rHessian_22) - (rHessian_12 * rHessian_21);
IF ABS(rDetHess) < 0.0001 THEN rDetHess := 0.0001; END_IF;

rInvHess11 := rHessian_22 / rDetHess;
rInvHess12 := -rHessian_12 / rDetHess;
rInvHess21 := -rHessian_21 / rDetHess;
rInvHess22 := rHessian_11 / rDetHess;

(* Unconstrained Newton-Raphson Step: Delta_u = - H^-1 * g *)
rDeltaSwash_L_Opt := -(rInvHess11 * rGradient_1 + rInvHess12 * rGradient_2);
rDeltaSwash_R_Opt := -(rInvHess21 * rGradient_1 + rInvHess22 * rGradient_2);

(* 8.5 Projected Box Constraints: Slew Rate (+/- 8.0%/cycle) & Swashplate Saturation *)
IF rDeltaSwash_L_Opt > 4.0 THEN rDeltaSwash_L_Opt := 4.0; END_IF;
IF rDeltaSwash_L_Opt < -4.0 THEN rDeltaSwash_L_Opt := -4.0; END_IF;
IF rDeltaSwash_R_Opt > 4.0 THEN rDeltaSwash_R_Opt := 4.0; END_IF;
IF rDeltaSwash_R_Opt < -4.0 THEN rDeltaSwash_R_Opt := -4.0; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 9: DUAL ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC SYNCHRONOUS TORQUE & ASR ANTI-SPIN REGULATION          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 9.1 Koren Cross-Coupling Synchronization Error *)
(* e_sync = (v_L - v_R) - TrackGauge * omega_yaw_ref *)
rCrossCouplingError := (rTrackTheoreticalSpeed_L - rTrackTheoreticalSpeed_R) - (CONST_TRACK_GAUGE_B * aMPC_Target[1]);
rCrossCouplingIntegral := rCrossCouplingIntegral + rCrossCouplingError * 0.050;
(* Bound integral term to prevent windup *)
IF rCrossCouplingIntegral > 0.50 THEN rCrossCouplingIntegral := 0.50; END_IF;
IF rCrossCouplingIntegral < -0.50 THEN rCrossCouplingIntegral := -0.50; END_IF;

(* Synchronous Compensator: Modifies individual swashplates *)
rSyncCompensatorOut := 18.5 * rCrossCouplingError + 4.2 * rCrossCouplingIntegral;

(* 9.2 Anti-Slip Regulation (ASR) Slip Overrides *)
IF rPortTrackSlipRatio > rSlipLimitThreshold THEN
    bASR_Interlock_Port := TRUE;
    rASR_TorqueScaleFactor_L := 0.25; (* Aggressively cut Port pump swashplate displacement *)
    dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Port Track Excessive Slip *)
ELSE
    bASR_Interlock_Port := FALSE;
    rASR_TorqueScaleFactor_L := 1.00;
    dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 AND 16#FFFB;
END_IF;

IF rStbdTrackSlipRatio > rSlipLimitThreshold THEN
    bASR_Interlock_Stbd := TRUE;
    rASR_TorqueScaleFactor_R := 0.25; (* Aggressively cut Stbd pump swashplate displacement *)
    dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Stbd Track Excessive Slip *)
ELSE
    bASR_Interlock_Stbd := FALSE;
    rASR_TorqueScaleFactor_R := 1.00;
    dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 AND 16#FFF7;
END_IF;

(* 9.3 Hydraulic Torque Equalization Cross-Tie Valve *)
rPressureImbalanceDiff := ABS(rVoted_Press_PortDrive - rVoted_Press_StbdDrive);
IF rPressureImbalanceDiff > 25.0 AND ABS(aMPC_Target[1]) < 0.02 THEN
    (* Vehicle driving straight on soft clay with pressure split: open cross-tie valve to balance *)
    rHydraulicCrossTieValveCmd := MIN((rPressureImbalanceDiff - 25.0) * 1.5, 60.0);
ELSE
    rHydraulicCrossTieValveCmd := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 9.4 Integrate Swashplate Commands with Slew Limiters *)
rPortSwashplateInternal := rPortSwashplateInternal + rDeltaSwash_L_Opt - (0.5 * rSyncCompensatorOut);
rStbdSwashplateInternal := rStbdSwashplateInternal + rDeltaSwash_R_Opt + (0.5 * rSyncCompensatorOut);

(* Apply ASR Derating *)
rPortSwashplateInternal := rPortSwashplateInternal * rASR_TorqueScaleFactor_L;
rStbdSwashplateInternal := rStbdSwashplateInternal * rASR_TorqueScaleFactor_R;

(* Absolute Clamping to Swashplate Physical Travel [-100.0%, +100.0%] *)
IF rPortSwashplateInternal > 100.0 THEN rPortSwashplateInternal := 100.0; END_IF;
IF rPortSwashplateInternal < -100.0 THEN rPortSwashplateInternal := -100.0; END_IF;
IF rStbdSwashplateInternal > 100.0 THEN rStbdSwashplateInternal := 100.0; END_IF;
IF rStbdSwashplateInternal < -100.0 THEN rStbdSwashplateInternal := -100.0; END_IF;

(* Assign Physical Outputs *)
rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := rPortSwashplateInternal;
rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := rStbdSwashplateInternal;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 10: MULTI-STAGE MAIN FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                                  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
tonStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#3600S);
IF iState <> iPrevState THEN
    rStateTimeAccumulator := 0.0;
    bStateFirstCycle := TRUE;
    iPrevState := iState;
ELSE
    rStateTimeAccumulator := rStateTimeAccumulator + 0.050;
    bStateFirstCycle := FALSE;
END_IF;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: ABYSSAL INITIALIZATION & DIAGNOSTIC VERIFICATION                         *)
       (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
        rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
        rPortSwashplateInternal := 0.0;
        rStbdSwashplateInternal := 0.0;
        bPortMotorHighDisplacement := TRUE;
        bStbdMotorHighDisplacement := TRUE;
        bEmergencyBallastReleasePermissive := FALSE;
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0001; (* State: Init *)

        IF bSystemEnableMaster AND bHydraulicPowerUnitRunning AND (rVoted_Press_Compensator >= 1.20) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Compensation Arming *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: HYDROSTATIC PRESSURE COMPENSATION ARMING & NITROGEN PRECHARGE CHECK    *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0002; (* State: Pressure Arming *)
        IF rVoted_Press_Hydrostatic < 550.0 THEN
            (* Warning: Crawler not at abyssal depth (>5500m) *)
            dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Shallow Depth Warning *)
        END_IF;

        IF rStateTimeAccumulator > 3.0 THEN
            IF rVoted_Press_Compensator >= 1.50 AND rVoted_Press_Compensator <= 2.80 THEN
                iState := 20; (* Proceed to Sediment Terramechanical Probe *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: SEDIMENT SHEAR CALIBRATION MICRO-INCH PROBE                            *)
        (* Applies micro-torque pulse to determine in-situ c_u and Janbu K_w                *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0004; (* State: Shear Calibration *)
        rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := 8.0; (* 8% pilot displacement pulse *)
        rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := 8.0;

        IF rStateTimeAccumulator > 2.5 THEN
            (* Evaluate initial sediment shear response *)
            IF rVoted_Press_PortDrive > 180.0 THEN
                (* High resistance clay: stiff cohesive sediment *)
                rSedimentCohesion_Nominal := 6.50;
            ELSE
                (* Ultra-soft abyssal pelagic ooze *)
                rSedimentCohesion_Nominal := 2.20;
            END_IF;
            rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
            rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
            iState := 30; (* Proceed to Acoustic/Inertial Alignment *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: USBL INERTIAL ALIGNMENT & DVL BOTTOM-LOCK STATION KEEP                 *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0008; (* State: Acoustic Alignment *)
        rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
        rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;

        IF bDVL_BottomLockValid AND (rUSBL_AcousticSNR >= 10.0) AND (rEKF_ConfidenceIndex >= 70.0) THEN
            IF bAutonomousNavPermissive THEN
                iState := 40; (* Proceed to Autonomous Synchronous Crawl *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: AUTONOMOUS SYNCHRONOUS TRACTION CRAWL (NOMINAL OPERATION)              *)
        (* Full MPC optimization, 2oo3 TMR voting, and Cross-Coupling Drive Synchronization  *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0010; (* State: Autonomous Crawl *)
        (* Normal continuous execution handled in Sections 8 & 9 *)

        (* Transition to Acoustic Dropout Dead-Reckoning upon USBL loss *)
        IF bAcousticDropoutActive THEN
            iState := 60;
        END_IF;

        (* Transition to Single-Drive Degraded Limp upon severe drive fault *)
        IF (dwSensorVotingFaultWord AND 16#0000_0011) <> 0 THEN
            iState := 70;
        END_IF;

    50: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 50: CLAY SLIP MITIGATION & BELLY GROUNDING ROCKING RECOVERY                *)
        (* Executes oscillatory reverse-forward rock to clear fluidized mud & regain shear  *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0020; (* State: Belly Recovery *)
        rHydraulicCrossTieValveCmd := 0.0;
        
        IF rStateTimeAccumulator < 2.0 THEN
            (* Step 1: Immediate Reverse Crawl to Back Out of Scoured Mud Trench *)
            rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := -25.0;
            rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := -25.0;
        ELSIF rStateTimeAccumulator < 4.5 THEN
            (* Step 2: High-Displacement Crawl Forward at Ultra-Low Speed *)
            bPortMotorHighDisplacement := TRUE;
            bStbdMotorHighDisplacement := TRUE;
            rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := 12.0;
            rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := 12.0;
        ELSE
            (* Check whether Belly Margin Restored *)
            IF rBellyGroundingMargin > (CONST_CRITICAL_BELLY_CLR + 0.040) THEN
                iState := 40; (* Recovery successful, resume crawl *)
            ELSE
                (* Still grounded after rocking: Halt and request topside winch assist *)
                rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
                rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
                dwSystemAlarmWord1 := dwSystemAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Severe Belly Trap *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    60: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 60: ACOUSTIC DROPOUT DEAD-RECKONING (DVL + STRAPDOWN GYRO NAVIGATION)       *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0040; (* State: Dead Reckoning *)
        (* Maintain crawl setpoint using strictly DVL bottom-track velocity *)
        IF NOT bAcousticDropoutActive THEN
            iState := 40; (* Acoustic link restored, return to nominal *)
        END_IF;

        IF rStateTimeAccumulator > 300.0 THEN
            (* Dead-Reckoning timeout (>5 min without USBL): Stop to prevent navigation drift *)
            rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
            rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    70: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 70: HYDRAULIC CROSS-OVER DEGRADED LIMP-HOME MODE                           *)
        (* Single pump/motor failure: Modulates cross-tie valve to limps on healthy drive   *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0080; (* State: Degraded Limp *)
        iDegradationSeverityLevel := 3;
        rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := 15.0;
        rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := 15.0;
        rHydraulicCrossTieValveCmd := 85.0; (* Cross-connect circuit channels *)

    80: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 80: CRITICAL EMERGENCY BUOYANCY BALLAST RELEASE & SYSTEM SHUTDOWN          *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0100; (* State: Emergency Shutdown *)
        rPortPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
        rStbdPumpSwashplateCmd := 0.0;
        rHydraulicBypassDumpValve := 100.0; (* Full dump *)
        
        tonBallastArmingDelay(IN := bBuoyancyEmergencyDropArmed, PT := T#2S);
        IF tonBallastArmingDelay.Q THEN
            bEmergencyBallastReleasePermissive := TRUE; (* Jettison 8-tonne ballast weight *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 11: COMPREHENSIVE DIAGNOSTIC ALARM BITMASK ASSEMBLY                               *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rHydraulicFluidTemp > 55.0 THEN
    dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* High Hydraulic Fluid Temp *)
END_IF;

IF rVoted_Press_PortDrive > (rMaxHydraulicPressureBar - 15.0) THEN
    dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Port Circuit Near Relief Bar *)
END_IF;

IF rVoted_Press_StbdDrive > (rMaxHydraulicPressureBar - 15.0) THEN
    dwSystemAlarmWord2 := dwSystemAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Stbd Circuit Near Relief Bar *)
END_IF;

(* Update Active Supervisory Telemetry *)
iActiveSupervisoryState := iState;
